jobs.description:
Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
As our Creator Marketing Coordinator, you will play a key role in the day-to-day execution of influencer marketing campaigns across multiple markets. Working closely with creator marketing specialists, agencies, creators, and internal stakeholders, you'll help ensure campaigns are delivered smoothly, on time, and aligned with our creative and business objectives. This is a hands-on coordination role suited for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities at once and solving challenges along the way. 
Take part in the planning, organization, and execution of creator marketing campaigns.  
Ensure all necessary materials and assets are provided to creators and agencies, and campaigns are launched on schedule. Review influencer content to ensure it meets brand guidelines and campaign objectives before publishing.  
Serve as the primary point of contact between the brand, agencies, and creators. Manage communications, briefings, and approvals, ensuring expectations and timelines are clear and adhered to.  
Monitor and support live campaigns, helping track campaign performance and key metrics while identifying opportunities for optimization and improvement.   
Assist in managing campaign budgets, tracking expenses, and ensuring cost-effective use of resources. Liaise with finance and legal teams on contracts and payments as needed.  
Maintain and nurture relationships with creators, ensuring they feel supported and motivated to deliver their best work for the brand. Assist in identifying new creators for future partnerships.  
Act as the first line of support to resolve any campaign-related issues that arise with influencers or agencies, from delays to miscommunications or content concerns. 
 

 
WHO YOU ARE  
We are looking for people with…  
Experience working with influencer marketing, creator partnerships, social media campaigns or similar marketing activations in the US, with great understanding of SoMe platforms such as TikTok and Instagram.   
Passionate about staying up to date with social media trends and a strong understanding of the younger audience and what creates engaging activations.   
Comfortable working with campaign data, reporting, and performance tracking.   
Experience working with the US market and/or exposure to affiliate marketing are considered advantages.   
Fluent in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.   
 

And people who are…  
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly. You are proactive, solution-oriented and enjoy finding ways to make things happen.   
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Able to structure and manage large volumes of deliverables, parallel campaigns, and reporting thereof.  
You thrive while juggling multiple projects and deliverables at the same time, maintaining calm and good judgment. 
 

 
WHO WE ARE  
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.  
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
 
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities across the globe. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas matter.  
 
JOIN US  
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things - our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.  
This is a full-time permanent position based in Stockholm. Please apply as soon as possible by submitting your CV in English. Due to data privacy regulations, we only accept applications through our career page.  
We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Are you curious about how new technology can improve customer service in practice? Join our Dynamics Product team and combine business analysis with hands-on exploration of Dynamics 365 Customer Service, data and AI-related capabilities.  
With us, you get to take ideas from “could this help?” to tested examples and clear recommendations, helping our service teams create a consistent and effective customer experience across email, chat and voice.  
Your mission 
We run the Dynamics 365 Customer Service solution across Sandvik Coromant and our sister divisions. Working closely with users and stakeholders, you explore needs, analyze usage and help determine what the team should develop next and why. You belong to a cross-functional product team and collaborate throughout the full delivery process. 
Job responsibilities 
Work with users and stakeholders across divisions to understand their needs, processes and underlying challenges.  
Explore new Dynamics 365 capabilities, test AI agents and create small proofs of concept.  
Query data and build reports to understand usage, identify problems and evaluate improvements. 
Support prioritization by assessing business value, effort and risk. 
Translate findings into user stories and acceptance criteria, working with developers, testers and architects.  
Support testing and adoption, prepare training material and maintain functional documentation. 

 
Location and flexibility 
The preferred location for this position is Sandviken, Sweden. Solna, Sweden or Pune, India could also be an option.  We offer a hybrid solution, with the possibility to work some days from home.  
Your profile 
You have a university degree in IT or related field, or the equivalent practical experience, together with several years of experience from a relevant position. A solid understanding of customer service operations helps you distinguish between what users ask for and the underlying problems they need to solve.  
Your background includes 
Experience in business analysis and translating business needs into clear requirements.  
Confidence working directly on digital platforms and learning through experimentation. 
The ability to query data and create reports independently. 
Strong communication skills in English.  
Hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Service and AI agents is a strong advantage.  

Curious and practical, you enjoy moving between user conversations, data analysis and hands-on testing. You communicate complex topics clearly, challenge assumptions constructively and feel confident to recommend against a feature when it doesn’t solve the actual problem.  
The team 
You join a small, cross-functional product team of business analysts, testers and developers. Together, you work in an agile setup with short sprints and collaborate with users and stakeholders across divisions.  
Our culture 
Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career opportunities in an inspiring global environment. 
Contact information 
Are you curious to know more about this position? Please contact Jon Dahlgren, hiring manager, at jon.dahlgren@sandvik.com 
We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contact in that matter.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Vi söker legitimerad lärare i fritidshem - Vikariat 20270107 - 20271220

IES i Landskrona öppnades 2017, och är en F-9 skola. Här möts dagligen närmare 600 elever samt närmare 70 medarbetare. Vi är en tvåspråkig skola, engelska-svenska, som följer den svenska läroplanen. Våra möten sker mestadels på engelska. Att jobba i vår skola är att vara del av en professionell gemenskap och samarbete.

Om tjänsten

Vill du vara med och skapa trygga, roliga och meningsfulla dagar för våra yngsta elever? Vi söker en engagerad  legitimerad lärare i fritidshem som brinner för social utveckling, rörelse och aktivitet både i klassrummet och ute på skolgården.

I den här rollen har du en central funktion under hela elevens skoldag. Ditt fokus täcker tre viktiga områden:

- Fritidshem (Placering i Förskoleklass): Du planerar och leder den pedagogiska verksamheten på fritidshemmet tillsammans med ditt arbetslag, med särskilt fokus på eleverna i förskoleklass.
- Rastverksamhet under skoltid: Du ansvarar för att strukturera, planera och genomföra aktiva och inkluderande rastaktiviteter. Du finns där som en närvarande vuxen som främjar rörelseglädje, stimulerar lek och förebygger utanförskap och konflikter.
- Samverkan i skolan: Du samverkar med klasslärare under skoltiden för att skapa en sammanhållen dag för eleverna.Vi söker dig som:

- Är legitimerad lärare i fritidshem (eller har en äldre examen som grundskollärare med inriktning mot fritidshem).
- Har ett starkt intresse för rastpedagogik och ser rasten som en viktig lärandemiljö för sociala färdigheter och trygghet.
- Har erfarenhet av – eller ett särskilt engagemang för – arbete med barn i förskoleklass.
- Är en trygg, relationsskapande och närvarande vuxen med god förmåga att skapa struktur och studiero.
- Har god samarbetsförmåga och trivs med att arbeta i nära team runt eleverna.

Vad erbjuder vi?

- En dynamisk arbetsplats där fritidshemmet och rastverksamheten ses som viktiga delar av elevens hela skoldag.
- Ett kollegialt sammanhang med erfarna pedagoger och ett starkt stöd i arbetslaget.
- Möjlighet att forma och utveckla skolans rastaktiviteter.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är en trygg och tydlig ledare, lyhörd och empatisk i ditt bemötande av elever. Du skapar engagemang och delaktighet, bygger goda relationer och möter varje elev med respekt och värme. Du ser möjligheter istället för hinder och hanterar konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.

Vi söker dig som

- Är legitimerad lärare i fritidshem
- Har en positiv elevsyn och sätter eleven i centrum
- Trivs med att arbeta i team och värdesätter kollegialt samarbete
- Är väl insatt i och arbetar utifrån Lgr22 (fritidshemmets uppdrag)
- Är engagerad, strukturerad och utvecklingsinriktad
- Har god digital kompetens och använder digitala verktyg i verksamheten
- Kommunicerar väl med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare

Hos oss är trygghet och studiero viktigt, vilket innebär att du behöver vara säker i din yrkesroll och ha förmåga att skapa ett gott socialt klimat i elevgrupperna. Du är en lagspelare med hög arbetsmoral och trivs med att arbeta med människor i en internationell skolmiljö.

Du har god förmåga att samverka och kommunicera samt en vilja att vara med och utveckla vår verksamhet. Våra digitala plattformar är Google och SchoolSoft.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan och hoppas att du vill bli en del av vårt fritidsteam på IES Landskrona!

Löpande intervjuer sker, skicka din ansökan till: eva.andersson.landskrona@engelska.se

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

jobs.occupation: Product Assurance Manager to Beyond Gravity Gothenburg
jobs.description:
🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​
 
About Beyond Gravity
Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1'900 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and produce solutions for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com.
 
Your crew
As a Product Assurance Manager you'll be part of the Quality Department, responsible for the development, implementation and verification of the Product Assurance requirements among entire project life. The Product Assurance Manager will act as main interface to the customer and the subcontractors for quality and safety topics. Quality Management at Beyond Gravity is all about ensuring a Learning Organization that leads the Space Industry improvement rate and garantees customer satisfaction.
 
Your mission
Develop the Product Assurance Requirements and Culture at project level, ensuring robust quality processes, cost excellence for program quality execution through collaboration with Programs, Engineering and Operations.
Act as main interface for Customer for all quality and safety topics.
Establish Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) features in collaboration with Customer and Engineering.
Lead NC and failure investigation whenever product requirements are violated.
Supervise and direct Product Development and Qualification for all relevant quality aspects.
Coordinate for all Quality matters international multi-site and cross-country programs.

 
Main Tasks:
Execute Product Assurance Program in accordance with Project Milestones.
Ensure successful execution of the Customer, Regulatory and Internal Requirements for Program Execution.
Convert the Customer Critical to Quality Requirements into internal specifications and requirements.
Lead Customer Critical RCA and investigation activities.
Moderate Design FMEA.
Develop Process/Product CTQ and Control Plans in collaboration with Customer and Engineering.
Establish Product Quality Documentation.
Support and achieve final Product Qualification.
Contribute as needed to Customer and internal Audit as Quality representative.

 
Most important output
Contribute to Customer Satisfaction for Quality Performance
Quality Milestone Achievements for Projects
Design FMEA
Product CTQs Development (Control Plans)
Product Quality data-package for Space Application
Final Product Qualification data-package for Space Application
Customer RCA and NC Report

 
Your story
Must’s:
Relevant experience in the field of Quality and Continuous Improvement
Preferred education: MSc degree in Engineering or in a similar relevant discipline
Knowledge of standards such as EN9100, ECSS, NASA and MIL
Ability to quickly understand and analyse technical products/systems and their function
Excellent written and oral communication skills in English
MS Office experience required
Experience in the application of Quality preventive methodology (5Why, Ishikawa Fishbone…)

 
Nice to have’s:
Any further language (German, French and Swedish) beyond English is a strong asset
Experience in other Space companies

 
Why Beyond Gravity
To work in a growing high technology company with career opportunities within the site or internationally.
You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!
We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with!
 
🌌Are you ready for lift-off?​
Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.​
​
For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact: ​Catarina Rio |  | catarina.afonsorio@beyondgravity.com 
Beyond Gravity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected categories.​
​
Applications by e-mail cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruitment agencies for this position.

ABOUT THE ROLE    

We’re looking for a BI Engineer to join our Business Intelligence Engineering team at LeoVegas Group. You’ll work across the full BI stack, from modelling data in BigQuery to building the dashboards senior leaders use to run a multi-brand, multi-jurisdiction iGaming business.
This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership. We treat our reporting as data products, built to scale and to last, and we’re moving our BI platform to Sigma, so you’ll help shape how we build on it from early on. If you enjoy writing clean SQL, solving messy data problems, and seeing your work shape decisions across the business, we’d love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
Design, build, and maintain scalable presentation-layer datasets using SQL, dbt, Python, Airflow, and BigQuery on GCP.

Choose the right materialisation strategies and follow CI/CD practices to keep our models reliable, performant, and cost-efficient.
Design and maintain a semantic layer with governed, consistent metric definitions that power both dashboards and AI-driven self-service, so stakeholders can ask questions of the data in natural language and trust the answers.
Build interactive dashboards in Sigma, our strategic BI platform, while supporting existing Tableau reporting during the transition, working alongside Business Analysts and applying data storytelling principles that encourage self-service analytics.
Apply a data product mindset to everything you deliver, building reporting that is reusable, well-documented, and designed for long-term impact.
Partner with our Data Engineering team on upstream pipeline changes, investigate data issues through root-cause analysis, and help improve the platform we build on.
Work directly with stakeholders across Commercial, Finance, Compliance, Operations, Payments, Data Science, Marketing, and Product to understand their needs and translate them into well-designed data solutions.
Help harmonise KPIs and metric definitions across brands and BI platforms.
Champion data quality, documentation, and consistent metric definitions so people can trust what they see.
Keep learning, and share useful tools, techniques, and ideas with the team.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Essential:
2-5 years of experience in a BI Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or similar role.

Advanced SQL, with a solid grasp of data modelling concepts (for example, dimensional modelling).
Hands-on experience with at least one modern BI tool, ideally Sigma or Tableau.
The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues and senior management.
Clear, concise written documentation that others can actually use.
A structured, curious approach to problem-solving and debugging data issues.

Nice to have:
Experience in the iGaming industry (Sportsbook and/or Casino).

Python, Airflow, and dbt.
Experience with BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse, and with GCP more broadly.
Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows.
Exposure to Sigma

 
WHO WE ARE
At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.
 
BENEFITS:
Hybrid work policy

4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply)
30 annual vacation days
Occupational Pension
5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually
Parental Leave Top-Up
Possibility to enrol in a private health care insurance for both you and your partne
Benify - benefits portal with many offers and discounts
 
 

JOIN US!
In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!
Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar!
 
As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

jobs.description:
Elevassistent Internationella Engelska Skolan Sigtuna 

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) Sigtuna söker nu en lugn, professionell och engagerad elevassistent för att stötta en yngre elev under skoldagen och inom fritidsverksamheten. 

På IES Sigtuna tror vi att alla elever ska ha tillgång till en trygg, strukturerad och inkluderande lärmiljö där de ges möjlighet att utvecklas både kunskapsmässigt och socialt. Vi söker därför en ansvarstagande och relationsskapande vuxen som kan ge stöd utifrån en enskild elevs behov samtidigt som elevens självständighet, delaktighet och trygghet står i centrum. 

IES Sigtuna är en tvåspråkig F–9-skola med cirka 600 elever och 65 medarbetare från hela världen. Vi följer den svenska läroplanen och erbjuder upp till 50 % undervisning på engelska. Vår skolkultur bygger på tydliga rutiner, starka relationer och ett tydligt fokus på elevernas trygghet och utveckling. 

Om tjänsten 

Som elevassistent kommer du att arbeta nära en yngre elev som är i behov av praktiskt och fysiskt stöd under skoldagen. Eleven använder rullstol och behöver stöd för att fullt ut kunna delta i undervisning, förflyttningar och skolans dagliga aktiviteter. 

Rollen innebär att stötta eleven både praktiskt och socialt under dagen med ett respektfullt, uppmuntrande och elevcentrerat förhållningssätt. En viktig del av uppdraget är att hjälpa eleven att delta så självständigt och naturligt som möjligt i skolans alla delar. 

Utöver stödet under skoldagen kommer tjänsten även att innebära stöd till eleven inom fritidsverksamheten före och/eller efter skoldagen vid behov. 

Du kommer att samarbeta nära med lärare, vårdnadshavare, fritidspersonal och elevhälsoteamet för att säkerställa att elevens skoldag blir trygg, tillgänglig och positiv. 

Arbetsuppgifter 

- Stötta eleven under lektioner, raster, förflyttningar, fritids och andra skolaktiviteter 
- Ge praktiskt och fysiskt stöd under skoldagen 
- Bidra till att lärmiljöerna är tillgängliga och välstrukturerade 
- Uppmuntra delaktighet, självständighet och positiva kamratrelationer 
- Samarbeta nära med undervisande personal, vårdnadshavare, fritidspersonal och elevhälsoteamet 
- Stödja elevens kunskapsmässiga, sociala och emotionella utveckling 
- Bidra till en lugn, trygg och inkluderande skolmiljö  

Vi söker dig som: 

- Har ett genuint intresse för att arbeta med barn och unga 
- Är lugn, tålmodig, ansvarstagande och trygg i dig själv 
- Har god förmåga att skapa professionella och förtroendefulla relationer med elever och familjer 
- Förstår vikten av inkludering, värdighet och elevens självständighet 
- Är bekväm med att ge praktiskt stöd under skoldagen 
- Kan arbeta både självständigt och som en del av ett team 
- Har god kommunikativ förmåga på både svenska och engelska då båda språken är nödvändiga i rollen  

Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med elever i behov av särskilt stöd, fysisk stödinsats eller anpassade lärmiljöer är starkt meriterande. 

Vi erbjuder 

- Ett meningsfullt och givande arbete i en stöttande skolmiljö 
- Nära samarbete med erfarna kollegor och elevhälsoteam 
- En strukturerad och professionell arbetsmiljö 
- Möjlighet till professionell utveckling och lärande 
- Chansen att göra verklig skillnad i en elevs vardag  

Läs mer om vår skola här: IES Sigtuna 

Skicka din ansökan (CV och personligt brev) via IES Careers eller direkt till skolans rekryteringsansvarig. Rekrytering sker löpande.

Would you like to combine strategic sourcing with project work in an international environment? With us, you take global responsibility for procurement activities related to the projects you manage – in this case Seco Solva. You contribute from the quotation phase through to execution, ensuring that deliveries, costs, and timelines support project success and customer satisfaction.
 
Read more about Seco Solva and how we develop solutions together with our customers on our website.
 
About your job

Your primary focus is to lead and coordinate procurement work within the Solva project, while maintaining full responsibility for subcontracting and direct materials. You work closely with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders to ensure efficient procurement processes, strong supplier relationships, and compliance with applicable policies and requirements.

Handle supplier-related matters and support the organization in contract and supplier management issues.

You have strong business acumen and thrive in a role that combines analysis, collaboration, and negotiation. Experience in international procurement and working with diverse stakeholders provides a solid foundation for success. You communicate fluently in both Swedish and English and feel comfortable operating in a global organization.

Experience in international procurement within an industrial or similar business environment.

Experience working with sourcing processes, contracts, and supplier evaluations.

Are you technically minded and enjoy combining coordination, problem-solving and collaboration? In this role, you will play an important part in ensuring the availability and efficient utilization of a test vehicle fleet. Working closely with project management, test departments and other stakeholders, you will help keep operations running smoothly and contribute to the development of future trucks.
About the position
Perido are looking for a Test Fleet Engineer for our client, a large and well-known company in the automotive industry. The position is located in Gothenburg, where the work takes place on-site in the office.
Your daily tasks
The purpose of the Test Fleet Engineer is to secure maximum utilization of test vehicles through close collaboration with project management, test departments and workshops. You will be responsible for the truck uptime for the complete vehicle fleet, from delivery to divestment.
Your main responsibilities are:
Act as the first line of support to ensure vehicle uptime, and second-line support for field test trucks
Coordinate activities related to unplanned vehicle stops, including securing workshop resources and identifying, ordering and managing required materials
Plan and coordinate towing and special transportation between test sites
Coordinate resources and transport documentation required for importing and exporting vehicles to and from countries outside the EU
Optimize fleet utilization by analysing vehicle usage, maintaining an appropriate fleet size and planning timely vehicle divestments to minimize tied-up capital
Lead and follow up on actions related to unplanned stops and vehicle uptime in relevant project meetings
Communicate requirements, provide input and share knowledge with stakeholders whose activities affect vehicle uptime
Proactively ensure that projects meet Test Fleet Center requirements
Order materials and services from external partners and process related invoices.
Maintain test fleet vehicles between loan periods
Identify, lead, document and implement continuous improvements to the role and its processes

Your characteristics
We are looking for someone who is proactive, structured and solution-oriented, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks from start to finish. You have strong communication and collaboration skills and feel comfortable working with stakeholders across different functions and locations. You are able to connect strategic objectives with day-to-day activities, manage several parallel tasks and find effective solutions when challenges arise. You are also confident in your ability to manage projects and have a good understanding of vehicle technology and product development.
Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!
Please submit your application for this role in English.

jobs.occupation: Sales Lead & Key Account Manager, Sweden
jobs.description:
Out of Eden AB represents Esse Skincare in Sweden. Esse is a professional skincare brand built on the science of the skin microbiome, barrier function and long-term skin health. Our products are sold through professional salons and selected stockists across Sweden, with support from the Esse head office in South Africa. 
The role
We are now looking for a Sales Lead & Key Account Manager to lead and develop our sales in Sweden. You will be responsible for the growth strategy for the Swedish market and the relationships with our key accounts. You will also oversee the sales work of our three Account Managers. You will be the link between the Swedish market and our head office, making sure each side knows what the other needs to grow.
The role is based in the Gothenburg area, as most of our stockists are in western Sweden. It involves regular travel across Sweden and occasional travel to South Africa. You will report to the Head of Sales.
Main responsibilities
Growth plan and strategy

Analyse sales performance by account, region and salon to identify the biggest opportunities.

Develop and run a growth plan for Sweden for the coming one to two years, with clear targets.

Present the needs of the Swedish market to head office, such as resources, stock, marketing and training, with evidence to support them.

Own the sales pipeline for Sweden and report on progress.

Key account management

Be the main contact for all key accounts in Sweden, working closely with them in person.

Agree quarterly targets with each key account and follow up on results.

Plan approved promotions and campaigns in advance and share them with the key accounts.

Make sure key accounts operate according to agreed terms and conditions.

Overseeing the Account Managers

Oversee the three Account Managers in Sweden, set priorities and follow up on sales activity against targets.

Coach the Account Managers through joint customer visits and regular follow-up.

Support the Account Managers in finding new leads, partners and salons, and in developing existing customers.

Events, education and marketing

Organise Pro Summit, our two-day sales, education and marketing event for stockists held every September.

Plan and run the yearly events calendar for Sweden, including trade shows.

Plan and deliver training for Account Managers, stockists and salon teams.

Work with accounts and salons on how Esse marketing is used locally.

New business

Lead the work of opening new salons in the region, together with the Account Managers and personally for strategic accounts.

Your profile
Requirements

Experience coaching, training or leading salespeople.

Experience selling professional skincare to salons and working with key accounts or distributors.

A background in skin education or training of skin therapists, with a solid understanding of skin science and the microbiome.

Experience of training and presenting to groups, from salon teams to larger audiences.

Experience of planning and running events.

Fluent English, spoken and written.

A driving licence (B) and the ability to travel frequently within Sweden.

Meritorious

Experience working closely with an international head office.

Knowledge of Esse products.

Swedish, or a willingness to learn.

As a person, you are a salesperson at heart and comfortable opening doors and asking for the order. You are practical and adaptable, as the role develops with what the market needs. You work well independently, far from head office, while keeping colleagues and leadership well informed.
What we offer

A central role in developing the Swedish market for an international skincare brand.

A fixed monthly salary.

Pension contributions and insurance in line with market practice.

Practical information

Employer: Out of Eden AB

Form of employment: Permanent, full-time

Location: Gothenburg area, with travel across Sweden

How to apply
Apply via the link with your CV and a short cover letter in English.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Timvikarier till IES Värmdö

På Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) gör vi skillnad i våra elevers liv. Vi tror att detta beror på vår tydliga etos med engagerade och synliga ledare som skapar en miljö där elever lär sig och personal trivs och utvecklas. Våra skolor har en dynamisk internationell atmosfär med medarbetare och elever från hela världen.

IES Värmdö är en skola för årskurserna F-klass till 9 med cirka 610 elever och 68 medarbetare. Vi följer den svenska läroplanen och har upp till 50 % av undervisningen på engelska. Skolan öppnade i augusti 2021 och har under de senaste åren etablerat en stark skol- och fritidskultur präglad av trygghet, studiero och goda relationer.

Skolan ligger i Charlottendal i Gustavsberg, med enkel pendling från Stockholm. Det tar cirka 20 minuter med buss från Slussen och busshållplatsen ligger precis bredvid skolan.

Nu söker vi engagerade och flexibla timvikarier som vill arbeta hos oss vid behov, både inom undervisningen och i vår fritidsverksamhet.Om rollen

Som timvikarie hos oss ersätter du ordinarie personal vid exempelvis sjukdom eller annan frånvaro. Arbetsuppgifterna varierar beroende på skolans behov och kan innebära att du ansvarar för undervisning i olika årskurser, stöttar elever i klassrummet eller arbetar inom fritidsverksamheten.

Vid undervisning följer du i första hand den planering som ordinarie lärare har lämnat och ansvarar för att skapa en trygg och strukturerad lärmiljö där eleverna kan fortsätta sitt arbete.

Inom fritidsverksamheten arbetar du tillsammans med kollegor för att skapa en trygg, aktiv och meningsfull eftermiddag för eleverna.

Vi söker dig som är trygg i mötet med barn och ungdomar, kan ta ansvar och snabbt anpassa dig till nya situationer. Du behöver vara en tydlig vuxen som kan skapa studiero, bygga goda relationer och samarbeta med skolans personal.

Eftersom vi är en tvåspråkig skola är det viktigt att du känner dig bekväm med att kommunicera både på svenska och engelska.Vi söker dig som

- har ett genuint intresse för att arbeta med barn och ungdomar
- är ansvarstagande, flexibel och kan arbeta självständigt
- har god förmåga att leda elevgrupper och skapa trygghet och studiero
- har lätt för att samarbeta och skapa goda relationer
- kan hoppa in med kort varsel vid behov
- gärna har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete inom skola, fritidshem eller annan pedagogisk verksamhet

Pedagogisk utbildning eller tidigare erfarenhet av undervisning är meriterande, men inget krav. Vi välkomnar även dig som studerar till lärare eller är intresserad av att arbeta inom skolan.Anställningsvillkor

Tjänsten är en timanställning med arbete vid behov. Arbetstiderna varierar utifrån skolans verksamhet och personalbehov, främst under vardagar och skoltid. Det finns möjlighet att arbeta både enstaka dagar och mer regelbundet beroende på behov och tillgänglighet.

För att arbeta hos oss behöver du ha rätt att arbeta i Sverige samt kunna uppvisa ett giltigt utdrag ur belastningsregistret för arbete inom skola.Ansökan

Välkommen med din ansökan och CV till maria.nyhammar.varmdo@engelska.se. Ange gärna din tillgänglighet och om du har särskilda önskemål om vilka årskurser eller verksamheter du vill arbeta inom.

Vi går igenom ansökningar och intervjuar kandidater löpande.

Välkommen till IES Värmdö!

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

jobs.occupation: Head of Batteries and Power Electronics - Procurement
jobs.description:
Company description:
Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.
 
Job description:   Let's introduce ourselves 
Would you like to lead a key part of our Procurement organisation and help shape the future of our Battery and Power & Electrics business?
  
 We are looking for an experienced and business-driven Head of Battery and Power & Electrics Procurement. In this role, you will set the strategic direction for the section, translate strategy into execution and create the conditions for your organisation to deliver sustainable business value.
  
 You will have overall accountability for the section and play an important role in strengthening our competitiveness, developing strategic supplier relationships and managing business-critical opportunities and risks.
  
 Working in a highly international environment, you will collaborate closely with senior stakeholders, suppliers and counterparts across functions and regions. Fluency in both Chinese and English is essential for the role.
  
 Just as importantly, you will lead through other leaders. We are looking for someone who builds capability, creates accountability and develops a high-performing organisation that can navigate change and ambiguity with confidence.
 What you'll do 
As Head of Battery and Power & Electrics Procurement, you will:
  
  Set the strategic direction for the Battery and Power & Electric Procurement section, translating company and Procurement priorities into clear objectives, plans and execution.
 Lead, develop and empower leaders and teams, building organisational capability, accountability and a strong performance culture.
 Drive business and procurement performance, balancing commercial value, cost, quality, delivery, risk and long-term competitiveness.
 Shape category and supplier strategies, developing strategic supplier relationships and ensuring external competitiveness while proactively managing business-critical opportunities and risks.
 Drive global and cross-regional alignment, collaborating closely with senior stakeholders and relevant counterparts across functions and geographies.
 Set direction for strategic negotiations and major commercial decisions, acting as a senior escalation point and enabling strong negotiation approaches across the organisation.
 Drive continuous improvement and transformation, challenging established ways of working and creating the conditions for simpler, faster and more effective execution.
  What you'll bring 
We believe you are a senior leader with a strong commercial mindset and the ability to combine strategic thinking with decisive execution.
  
 You bring:
  Significant experience from Procurement, Supply Chain, commercial leadership or another relevant business environment, with responsibility for complex and business-critical scopes.
 Demonstrated experience leading leaders and professional organizations, building capability and creating sustainable performance.
 Strong business and commercial acumen especially on battery area, with the ability to translate strategy into clear priorities, decisions and measurable outcomes.
 Extensive experience of complex negotiations, strategic supplier relationships and senior stakeholder management.
 The ability to lead and make sound decisions in situations where information is incomplete, priorities compete and the way forward is not always obvious.
 Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to create clarity, alignment and engagement across functions, cultures and geographies.
 Fluency in Chinese and English, both written and spoken.
 A proactive leadership approach, taking ownership while creating accountability and empowerment throughout the organization.
  
 
  
 You might also have
  Experience from electrification, powertrain/driveline, automotive or another technology-intensive industrial environment.
 Experience leading major transformation, organisational change or cross-functional business initiatives.
 Broad experience working across regions and cultures in a complex global organisation.
  
 
 The leadership we are looking for:
  
 You create direction without needing all the answers upfront. You are comfortable making decisions in complex situations and bringing people with you through clear priorities, open communication and visible ownership.
  
 You challenge constructively, simplify where possible and move the organisation forward. You combine high expectations with strong people leadership and create an environment where leaders and teams can perform, develop and take accountability.
  
 As Head of Battery and Power & Electrics Procurement, you will be expected to look beyond your immediate area, build alignment across organisational boundaries and contribute to the longer-term development and competitiveness of Procurement.

Lead a multifunctional category leadership team and create alignment across product, design, sourcing, digital and commercial functions to deliver category performance.
Align functions across reporting lines and balance category priorities with the needs of the wider business.
Drive the end-to-end development of the category, ensuring alignment across assortment strategy, product development, sourcing, production and commercial storytelling.

About you
You understand how customer behaviour, market developments and business performance translate into decisions that drive growth and results. You create clarity in complex situations, communicate with impact and enable others to take responsibility. You lead through change, address difficult issues constructively and bring different functions together around shared priorities.
You combine strong strategic and commercial leadership with deep fashion and product expertise. You understand how customer needs, assortment strategy, product development, sourcing and commercial execution work together to create profitable growth. You bring a strong product mindset and a passion for building desirable customer offers that drive both customer relevance and business results.
To succeed in this role, you need:
A relevant university degree.
Extensive experience within the relevant business area.
Extensive experience within retail/fashion retail, with significant experience from category management, assortment planning, buying, design, sourcing, product development or closely related disciplines.
Extensive leadership experience, including proven experience of leading leaders.
A proven track record of leading a business or significant business area with profit and loss responsibility.
Experience of driving organisational change, transformation and continuous improvement.
Experience of building and developing a fashion customer offer, assortment strategy and product portfolio that delivers both customer relevance and profitable growth.
Fluency in English.

It is advantageous if you have:
Experience from international fashion retail or consumer-driven brand businesses, with a strong focus on customer insight, brand building, and commercial growth.
Experience of leading across reporting lines and building trust with teams, functional managers and stakeholders.
Experience of using customer behaviour, business performance and operational data to support decision-making.
Experience of aligning business and digital stakeholders around shared priorities.

Location and application
The position is based at Lindex head office in Gothenburg and requires regular on-site presence. English is the working language.
We warmly welcome your application by November 22nd via maquire.se (https://maquire.se/lediga-jobb/). If you have any questions, please contact Claes Berggren, 0727-520374, claes.berggren@maquire.se
Maquire applies a fair selection process based on a clearly defined role profile. We do not use AI for screening or selection. Every application is reviewed by a human.

Company Description

Job Description

For this position it is important to know how to build and maintain business relations, having excellent communication skills, being a good team player, respecting values and being persistent.

Since we are working in a global context, you need to have good communicative skills and speak fluently English. Travelling is a part of the assignment since our Engineers spend a lot of time with our suppliers. You are interested to take your next step in a big global company to develop yourself further and to develop IKEA Food together with us!

Qualifications

As a Production Engineer you lead the engineering and quality agenda with the overall goal to improve the customer satisfaction. You are the main contact towards the suppliers and work as part of the business team together with the supplier to develop and secure the production processes, handling of quality deviations and secure compliance to all IKEA requirements. Amongst others you are:
are expert in quality assurance and follow up
are familiar with product audits and production risk assessments at supplier sites
are responsible for supplier development so you have experience in lean manufacturing and six sigma
are leading the continuous improvements agenda from a production perspective
have the interest and drive to build trust and partnership to reach common goals

For us at IKEA, the most important thing is that our co-workers share our values. We offer a fun, dynamic and challenging position in a global organization.

Additional Information

Please note this is a temporal position for 12 months.

Does this sound right for you? Please send in your application in English as soon as possible but no later than 17th November 2026. We will be interviewing continuously so please send in you application soonest possible
If you have any questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Femina Karlsson, People and Culture Specialist at femina.ladhani.karlsson@inter.ikea.com. If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Mattias Ellerth, Business Development Manager at mattias.ellerth@inter.ikea.com

jobs.occupation: Service Coordinator to an International Company in the MedTech Industry!
jobs.description:
Are you a Finnish speaking professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders? Do you have experience in service coordination and a passion for problem-solving, planning, and delivering excellent customer service? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!
We are currently looking for a Service Coordinator to join a well-established international company within the medical technology industry. In this role, you will play an important part in ensuring efficient service operations and providing high-quality support to customers in the healthcare sector.
You will primarily support the Finnish market and become part of a collaborative Nordic service organization.
About the Role:
As a Service Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating and managing service requests from the initial customer contact through to completion and follow-up. You will play a key role in ensuring smooth daily operations by making sure the right resources are available at the right time.
The position involves frequent incoming calls and extensive customer interaction. You will work closely with customers, service technicians, and internal teams to schedule, prioritize, and follow up on service activities.
You will be working in an international environment where English is the common business language, while Finnish will be essential in your daily communication with customers.
Your Main Responsibilities:
Receive and manage incoming service requests via phone and other communication channels.
Plan, schedule, and coordinate service technicians based on customer needs and available resources.
Monitor service cases from initial request through to completion, ensuring timely follow-up.
Handle rescheduling, unexpected changes, and urgent service requests while maintaining efficient operations.
Maintain regular communication with customers regarding planned and ongoing service activities.
Collaborate closely with service technicians, fellow coordinators, sales representatives, and project managers.
Handle administrative tasks related to service orders, order confirmations, service agreements, and invoicing documentation.
Ensure accurate documentation and updates in relevant business and service management systems.

About you:
We are looking for someone with previous experience in service coordination, service administration, technician scheduling, or a similar role involving the coordination and follow-up of multiple service cases.
You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and enjoy having the phone as one of your primary communication tools. You know how to stay calm and organized when priorities change, customers require immediate assistance, or several tasks need your attention simultaneously.
To Succeed in This Role, We Believe You Have:
Previous experience in service coordination, service administration, technician scheduling, or a similar position.
Experience managing service processes from incoming requests to completed assignments.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to coordinate and prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously.
Experience in a phone-intensive, customer-facing role, preferably within a B2B environment.
Good computer skills and experience working with administrative, CRM, ERP, or service management systems.
Excellent communication skills in Finnish and English, both written and spoken.

Experience within medical technology, technical services, installation, or industrial environments is highly advantageous. Familiarity with Salesforce Field Service Management (FSM), Salesforce, or SAP is also considered a plus.
Who Are You as a Person?
You are a communicative, solution-oriented, and service-minded individual who genuinely enjoys helping customers and building strong professional relationships.
You are comfortable handling a high volume of incoming calls, including conversations with customers who may be stressed or dissatisfied. You remain calm, professional, and focused on finding solutions.
You have a structured approach to your work and know how to prioritize effectively, even when several things are happening at once. You take ownership of your responsibilities, make confident decisions, and ensure that service cases are followed through to completion.
At the same time, you are a team player who enjoys collaborating with colleagues, sharing responsibilities, and supporting others when needed. You are flexible, adaptable, and comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change quickly.
Interested?
We would love to hear from you!
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: PR & Communications Specialist - Sales Market Sweden
jobs.employer_name: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO
As a PR & Communications Specialist – Internal Communications, you strengthen the brand by developing our Spokes Persons Engagement Plans and ensuring all internal and external communication aligns with global guidelines and brand values. You create and adapt communication materials, collaborate across teams, and support consistent messaging and crisis prevention.
Key responsibilities include:
Ensure all internal and external communications are consistent with brand values, customer centricity, and global guidelines.
Own and manage our internal communications platform, including publishing articles and updates.
Build and maintain strong relationships with opinion leaders, and key stakeholders while acting as a brand ambassador in external engagements.
Drive internal communications, adapt global content for local relevance, and collaborate cross-functionally to maximize impact across channels.
Own the Engagement Plan for Sales Market Sweden’s Spokes Persons.
Monitor market trends and manage crisis situations in collaboration with the media relations team
Optimize the annual Communications budget with a cost-conscious and entrepreneurial mindset.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
In this role, you will collaborate with multiple teams to ensure the successful expansion of the business. You will work closely with Communication Specialist Fashion PR, People Team, General Manager and Global Media Relations team, providing key insights and recommendations.
WHO YOU ARE
We are looking for people with…
Degree in Communications, PR, Marketing, or related field (or equivalent experience)
Strong internal and external communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience in media relations.
Experience supporting press events,in speaking events and  media briefings, and executive communication.
Solid awareness of industry trends, current affairs, and brand reputation topics.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Swedish.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
Minimum 7 years' experience in PR and/or communications, preferably within internal communications and stakeholder management in a  fashion, retail, or consumer brands setting. .

WHO WE ARE
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.
JOIN US
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
If you feel your experience, skills and ambitions are right for this role, apply by sending your application in ENGLISH through the career site as soon as possible but no later than November 5th, 2025. As we review applications continuously, the role may be closed early.  
This is a permanent position. The position is based in our Office in Stockholm and reports to Marketing Manager.
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Lärare i fritidshem sökes!

Vill du jobba i en internationell miljö med tydlig pedagogisk vision? 

Internationella engelska skolan har gjort stor skillnad för våra elever i 30 år. Vi är övertygade om att det är tack vare vårt tydliga etos med engagerad och närvarande lärare som våra skolor har en miljö där alla arbetar mot gemensamma mål. Vi har en stark kultur som bygger på beprövade rutiner. Hos oss får lärare fokus på undervisning och lärande. Eleverna står i centrum och alla elever är våra elever.

På Internationella engelska skolan är vi ett team som drar åt samma håll. För att tycka om att jobba hos oss bör du dela vår övertygelse om vikten av tydliga värderingar, kollegialt lärande och gemensamma rutiner och förhållningssätt.   

IES är stolta över sina medarbetare och har tagit fram en metod för att skapa en lugn och trygg skolmiljö. Detta gör att våra lärare får mer tid till att dela sin kunskap, både med elever och kollegor. Din egen undervisning sker på svenska men kollegor emellan talar vi engelska. 

Vi söker nu en legitimerad lärare i Fritidshem.

Tjänsten är på heltid. Tillträde gärna januari 2027 om möjligt. Provanställning tillämpas de första 6 månaderna. 

Tjänstebeskrivning

Arbeta som lärare i fritidshemmet. Du ingår i arbetslag fritids. Under skoldagen stöttar du elever på grupp- och individnivå.  I ditt arbete ingår att planera, genomföra och följa upp din undervisning utifrån LGR22. Du har ett nära samarbete med lärare i F-3. Du har en nära dialog med elevernas vårdnadshavare,   

Vi söker dig som vill vara med och göra skillnad för eleverna i deras livslånga lärande. Vår verksamhet genomsyras av ett positivt synsätt och vi har en stark tilltro till elevernas förmåga. En stark värdegrund och positiv elevsyn är mycket viktig för oss. Tillsammans med dina kollegor arbetar du för att skapa en trygghet, strukturerad, utvecklande och stimulerande lärmiljö för eleverna. Du arbetar tillsammans i team med lärarkollegor, stödpedagoger och fritidspersonal. Vårt uppdrag är att tillsammans leda och stötta eleverna i deras sociala och kunskapsmässiga utveckling. I teamet hjälps pedagogerna åt med planering, undervisning och elevernas skoldag. 

Vem är du?

Du har svensk lärarexamen med inriktning frididshem, samt svensk lärarlegitimation. Du har en klar pedagogisk insikt och förmåga att sätta läroplanens mål i ditt arbete. Du har ett tydligt ledarskap och står starkt i dina elevgrupper. Du är flexibel, strukturerad och väl förberedd. Du är en närvarande och medforskande pedagog som utmanar och stimulerar eleverna till utveckling. En stark tro på samarbete som en framgångsfaktor för den pedagogiska utvecklingen, är en självklarhet för dig. 

Du har en rak och ödmjuk kommunikation med vårdnadshavare och skapar tillitsfulla relationer till elever, vårdnadshavare samt kollegor. 

Du bör vara positiv och samarbetsvillig och beredd på att ingå i ett internationellt team.  

I din roll undervisar du på svenska. Kollegor emellan pratar vi svenska/engelska.

För mer information om vår skola, vänligen se https://engelska.se/our-schools/linkoping/

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan vilken du sänder till recruitment.linkoping@engelska.se Glöm inte att bifoga CV, personligt brev och din lärarlegitimation. Märk ansökan med ”Lärare Fritidshem VT27.

Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden gått ut, så skickas i din ansökan redan idag. Utdrag ur belastningsregistret uppvisas vid intervjuer.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.
